name: Banana Bread
author: martin-chrzanowski on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 1 1/2 cups mashed bananas (this is around 4-5 bananas)
1 cup sugar (brown or white is fine)

steps: Mix the wet ingredients (eggs, bananas, butter, sugar) in one bowl.
Mix the dry ingredients (flour, baking soda/powder, spices, salt) in another
Slowly add the wet to the dry while mixing.
Mix until dry bits of flour are gone.
Pour into lightly buttered or oiled loaf pan.
Bake for around an hour (it's definitely ready when a wooden skewer or
Chopstick poked inside comes out clean).

culture.text: Banana bread is a type of sweet bread or cake made from mashed bananas. Banana bread is typically classified as a quick bread, relying on chemical leavening agents such as baking soda or baking powder rather than yeast, which allows it to be prepared without fermentation. It is often a moist and sweet quick bread, but some recipes are yeast raised. Its sweet taste and slightly crumbly texture make it more akin to a tea cake or muffin than bread.
